description: This file defines utility functions for creating lazy-loaded runtime surfaces, modules, exports, and methods with cache mechanisms. It enables deferred execution and caching of dynamically imported modules or their parts.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeSurface<TModule, TSurface>( createLazyRuntimeSurface
methods.description: Creates a lazily loaded and cached runtime surface from a module importer and a selector function.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeModule<TModule>( createLazyRuntimeModule
methods.description: Creates a lazy-loaded runtime module with caching, wrapping the surface creation without a custom selector.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeNamedExport<TModule, const TKey extends keyof TModule>( createLazyRuntimeNamedExport
methods.description: Creates a lazy-loaded specific export from a module, identified by key, with caching.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeMethod<TSurface, TArgs extends unknown[], TResult>( createLazyRuntimeMethod
methods.description: Creates a lazily loaded method from a surface, with support for deferred loading and invocation.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeMethodBinder<TSurface>(load: () => Promise<TSurface>) { createLazyRuntimeMethodBinder
methods.description: Returns a binder function to create lazy runtime methods with cached surface loading.
